Class Position

java.lang.Object
chess.model.Position
public final class Position extends Object
An immutable square on the 8 x 8 board.

Coordinate mapping

  • row 0 is rank 8 (Black's back rank); row 7 is rank 1 (White's back rank).
  • col 0 is file A; col 7 is file H.
  • Therefore rank = 8 - row and file = 'A' + col.
  • Example: E2 maps to row 6, column 4.

A Position can never hold out-of-bounds coordinates: the constructor rejects them. This keeps every other class free of repeated bounds checks.
